12.t: Working with data: a bus journey
q: What is the top speed of the bus?
Calculate the acceleration in the first 10 s.
Calculate the distance between the stops (area under the graph).
Calculate the mean speed and explain why it is less than the top speed.
400 / 50 = 8 m/s. The bus spent 20 s speeding up and slowing down, below 10 m/s.
